messages:
maya: Heads-up: kicked off fp8 kernel canary for orca-mini-13b on the h100 warm pool. small batch shadow traffic only for now.

samir: nice. any baseline diffs already? :eyes:

maya: quick smoke looks fine for short prompts, but longprefix tests (>=2k tokens) show token-level perplexity spikes around token 512-768. not huge but consistent.

jin: can you paste the perf/log snippet?

maya: sure:
```
[2026-03-18 14:02:11] model=orca-mini-13b fp8_enable=true seq=2048 batch=1 kv_prefetch=on
... step 512 - ppl +0.12, kl_delta 0.09, nan=0
... step 640 - ppl +0.47, kl_delta 0.33
```

linda: those spikes map to kv-cache warmstart boundaries in our tiling handshake. we saw similar with fp8 on l40s a while back.

samir: hypothesis: mixed-precision handshake + prefetch microbatching introduces transient scale mismatch on last-attention blocks. fp8 block uses dynamic activation scaling that isn't synchronized with kv prefetch.

jin: could be. quick mitigation: force last 2 transformer blocks to fp16 (per-layer override) and re-run shadow. cheap to toggle.

maya: tried that — ppl deltas drop to +0.03 across longprefix tests. latency +2% though.

linda: tradeoff seems acceptable for canary. also increase warmup tokens from 8->64 to stabilize activation statistics before enabling fp8 path.

samir: we should also add a metric to the rollout: token-ppl-95, kl-99, and kv-prefetch-mismatch-rate. tie automatic rollback when ppl-95 > baseline+0.2 for 5min.

eval-bot: queued regression eval: longprefix suite (10 prompts), summary ETA 20m. will post granular diffs.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: pools=h100-warm-1, fraction=0.05, traffic=shadow-only.

maya: notes for postmortem if it fails: capture kernel trace (env FP8_TRACE=1), dump first 2 warmup tokens of kv cache, and collect per-layer scale vectors.

jin: also add a quick unit that locks the scaler seed to deterministic path to check if nondet scaling contributes.

samir: longer term: implement a lightweight handshake protocol where the fp8 scaler carries an explicit prefetch epoch id so kernels handshake on identical scaling context. avoids transient mismatch.

maya: agreed. for now: 1) enable per-layer fp16 overrides on last-2 blocks, 2) warmup_tokens=64, 3) add ppl-95 alert. rolling this to canary in 10m. :shipit:

linda: ack - i'll monitor eval-bot and perf dashboards. ping if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: regression summary: ppl median +0.04, ppl-95 +0.18 (below alert), kl max +0.07. no NaNs. full diffs at /evals/4901234567/longprefix/diff.html

maya: thanks — closing initial thread. follow-up ticket created: ENGML-7423 (fp8-handshake-prefetch-quirk).
